# 4 Ezra Chapter 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — First dialogue

---

**4:1** Then the angel who-had-been-sent to-me, whose name was Uriel, answered

**4:2** and said to-me: Your heart has utterly-failed in-regard-to this world, and do-you-think-to-comprehend the way of-the Most High?

**4:3** Then I said: Yes, my lord. And he answered me and said: I have-been sent to-show-you three ways and to-put-before-you three riddles.

**4:4** If you can-resolve for-me one of-these, I also will-show-you the way you-desire to-see and I will-instruct-you whence the evil heart-proceeds.

**4:5** Then I said: Speak, my lord. And he said to-me: Come, weigh for-me the heaviness of-fire; or-measure for-me a measure of-wind; or-recall for-me a day that-has-passed.

**4:6** I answered and said: Who-of-those-born-of-woman is-able to-do-this, that-you-ask me about these things?

**4:7** And he said to-me: If I had-asked-you: How-many dwellings are-in-the heart of-the sea, or-how-many springs are-at-the source of-the deep, or-how-many ways lead-out above the-firmament, or-which are-the exits of-Hades, or-which are-the paths of-paradise —

**4:8** perhaps you-would-have said to-me: I did-not go-down into the-deep, nor as-yet into Hades, neither did I ever-go-up into heaven.

**4:9** But now I have-asked-you about fire and wind and the day, things through-which you-have-passed, and without-which you-cannot-be-found, and you-have-given-me-no answer about-them.

**4:10** And he said to-me: Your own-things that-grow-up-with-you you-are-not-able to-know;

**4:11** and how-then-is your vessel able to-comprehend the way of-the Most High, and [how-can] the world, which-is-already corrupted beyond-measure, understand incorruption, which-is-already worn-out in-corruption?

**4:12** Then I said to-him: It-were-better that-we were-not-here at-all, than-that we-should-come-hither and live in-ungodliness, and suffer, knowing why we-suffer.

**4:13** And he answered me and said: Once the forests of-trees went-out to-battle against-the sea, that-they-might-drive-it-back, and the-sea likewise came to-battle against-the forest, that-it-might-take-possession-of-it.

**4:14** But the-counsel of-a tree was vain, for the-fire came and consumed-it.

**4:15** Likewise the-counsel of-the waves of-the sea was also vain, for the-sand stood-firm and withstood-it.

**4:16** If-now you-were the judge of-these two, whom would-you justify, and whom condemn?

**4:17** I answered and said: Both-of-them [it-was] a vain counsel, for the-land is-given to-the forest and the-place of-the sea [is-given] to carry its waves.

**4:18** Then he answered me and said: You-have-judged-well, and why have-you not-judged-so for-yourself also?

**4:19** For as-the-land is-given to-the forest and the-sea to its-waves, so-also they-who-dwell upon-the-earth can-understand only earthly things, and they-who-are above the-heavens, the-things that-are above-the-height of-the heavens.

**4:20** Then I answered and said: I beseech-you, my lord, wherefore was I given-the-ability to-understand?

**4:21** For I had-no-desire to-inquire about the ways of-the-Highest nor to-search-out the deep; I desired-only to-know the things which-pass-over us daily:

**4:22** wherefore Israel has-been given-over to-the-Gentiles as-a reproach; why the-people whom you loved has-been given-over to godless-tribes; why the-law of-our fathers has-been made-of-no-effect; and the written-covenants are-nowhere [to-be-found];

**4:23** and we-have-passed-away from-the world as-locusts, and our life-is as a-vapor, and we-are not-worthy to-obtain-mercy.

**4:24** But what-will he do to-his name which-is called-upon over-us? It-is about these things that-I-have-asked.

**4:25** Then he answered me and said: If-you-live long-enough you-will-be-marvelled-at; for the age is-hastening-to-its-end swiftly.

**4:26** For it-is-unable to-contain the things which-are-promised to-the righteous in-the appointed-times, for this age is-full of-grief and infirmities.

**4:27** For the evil-which-has-been-sown in it has-not-yet borne all its-fruit, and the field which-contains the evil-seed has-not-yet-come to-the full.

**4:28** For the grain of-evil-seed was sown in-the heart of-Adam from-the beginning, and how-much ungodliness has-it-brought-forth-until-now, and shall-bring-forth-until-the time-of-threshing comes!

**4:29** Consider now by-yourself how-great a-fruit of-ungodliness has-ripened;

**4:30** when-will then the-field of-the-sowing of-good-things be-cut-for-harvest, it-cannot-be-told, unless [it-be] after this time that-I-am-telling-you.

**4:31** I answered and said: How-long and when-will these-things-be? for our years are-few and evil.

**4:32** And he answered me and said: Do-not be-in-more-haste than the-Most-High; for you [are-in-haste] only for-yourself, but the-Exalted-One [is-in-haste] for-many.

**4:33** Were-not the-souls-of-the-righteous asking in-their-treasuries these very things: How-long are-we here? when-comes the-fruit of-the-threshing-floor of-our-reward?

**4:34** And to-these the archangel Jeremiel answered and said: Even when the-number of-those-like-yourselves is-filled-up; for he-has weighed the-age in-the-balance,

**4:35** and by-measure has-he-measured the-times, and by-number has-he-numbered the-seasons; and he-will not-move nor stir-them, until the-said-measure-be-fulfilled.

**4:36** Then I answered and said: O LORD who-art-above us, if-so-be all of-us also who-are-on the-earth — we-all know-it, so-much-the-more do-I-know-it.

**4:37** As the-pregnant-woman in-the-ninth-month, when-the-hour-of-her-delivery-draws-near her womb is-pained, so-is-it with-these places: they-shall-not-hesitate for-one-moment-longer-than-is-appointed-for-them.

**4:38** Then I answered and said: If-I-have-found grace before-you, and if-it-is-possible and I am-worthy,

**4:39** show-me this also: whether more-time is-to-come than-has-passed, or-whether the-greater part of-it has-gone-by already.

**4:40** I-heard the-things-that-have-passed-by, but know-not the-things-that-are-to-come.

**4:41** And he said to-me: Stand at-my right-hand, and I-will-show-you the-interpretation of-a-parable.

**4:42** And I stood and saw, and behold, a furnace burning-passed-before-me, and when-the-flame-had-passed-by I-looked, and behold, the smoke remained-still.

**4:43** And after-that a cloud full-of-water passed-before-me, and [after] the-heavy-rain-shower had-come-down [from-it] there-remained still drops in-the cloud.

**4:44** And he said to-me: Consider for-yourself: as-the rain is-more-than-the drops, and the fire is-greater-than-the smoke, so-the quantity that-is-past exceeded, but the drops and the smoke remained-still.

**4:45** Then I prayed and said: Do-I think-that I shall-live until-those days? or-who-shall-be-there in-those days?

**4:46** He answered me and said: Concerning-the signs about-which you-ask-me, I-am-able to-tell-you-in-part; but concerning-your life I-have-not-been-sent to-tell-you, and I-know-not.
